name.en-US: The Minor Legend of St. Francis

description.la: Legenda minor ad usum liturgicum, in septem capita et novem lectiones divisa, ex Legenda maiore a Bonaventura excerpta.
description.en-US: The short legend for liturgical reading, in seven chapters of nine lessons each, drawn from the Major Legend by St. Bonaventure. The Latin is the text of the Fonti francescane, with its scriptural cross-references.
description.pt-BR: A legenda breve para leitura litúrgica, em sete capítulos de nove lições cada, extraída da Legenda Maior por São Boaventura.

la.editor: Quaracchi (PP. Collegii S. Bonaventurae), after the Fonti francescane transcription

sources.edition: Text of the Quaracchi edition (Legendae duae de vita S. Francisci, 1898) as transcribed by M. Mastrorilli for the Biblioteca digitale Fonti francescane (rilievo.poliba.it, 2003), read from the Wayback Machine snapshot of 2005-11-11.
sources.description: Lines of numbered sentence units are joined into the sections of the edition; the modern "cfr." scriptural cross-references of the transcription stay in parentheses; stray grave and acute accents of the web transcription are removed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Latin is his text. The web transcription is an anonymous digitization for scholarly use.
